title: Antiferromagnetically Coupled Iron Ions in a Polynuclear FeIII–Dy Complex: Confirmation by Variable-Field 57Fe Mössbauer Spectroscopy

material_class.structural_family: Fe7Dy4 cluster with two fused Fe3DyO4 heterocubanes sharing a common Fe vertex and two fused Fe4O2 butterfly motifs

synthesis.procedure: To a stirred solution of [Fe3O(Piv)6(H2O)3]Piv (0.5 g, 0.5 mmol), Fe(NO3)3·9H2O (0.6 g, 1.5 mmol) and Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.9 g, 2 mmol) in MeCN (15 mL), a solution of H3tea (1.71 g, 11.5 mmol) in MeCN (5 mL) was gradually added. The resulting red solution was stirred at 80 °C for 25 min. The red acetonitrile fraction was separated by decantation from an aqueous fraction on the inner surface of the vessel, then further heated with stirring for 50 min at 80 °C. The solution was left undisturbed for 30 min before filtering. After several days, red-brown hexagonal prismatic crystals were collected, washed with acetonitrile and air-dried.
synthesis.time: 25 min then 50 min heating; 30 min standing; crystals after several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution in MeCN; decantation of the acetonitrile fraction from an aqueous film; filtration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The acetonitrile fraction was filtered after 30 min standing; red-brown hexagonal prismatic crystals formed after several days, washed with acetonitrile and air-dried.

properties.summary: dc susceptibility of 1 shows a rapid increase of χT between 29.0 and 2.8 K, indicating parallel-spin interactions, while variable-field 57Fe Mössbauer spectroscopy establishes that the FeIII ions are antiferromagnetically coupled (4:3 spin-up/spin-down sub-spectra at 5–6 T). The cluster is used as a test system and does not show improved SMM behaviour. Local Fe moments reorient toward the applied field (θ from 51.2° at 1 T to 64.1° at 6 T); Dy2 units are suggested to be ferromagnetically coupled with easy axes nearly collinear with the {Fe7} core.

measurements.name: χMT vs T
measurements.value: rapid increase of χT between 29.0 and 2.8 K

measurements.name: 57Fe Mössbauer magnetic hyperfine splitting
measurements.value: paramagnetic doublets at 77 K and above; magnetic sextet below ~40 K; at 5 and 6 T two sub-spectra with relative intensities 4:3
measurements.conditions: polycrystalline sample; 3.0–300 K; applied fields up to 6.5 T perpendicular to the γ-ray direction

measurements.name: angle θ between Heff and γ-rays
measurements.conditions: from relative intensities of Δm = 0 sextet lines

synthesis.procedure: Prepared similarly to 1, substituting Y(NO3)3·6H2O for Dy(NO3)3·6H2O. For 1, [Fe3O(Piv)6(H2O)3]Piv (0.5 g, 0.5 mmol), Fe(NO3)3·9H2O (0.6 g, 1.5 mmol) and Ln(NO3)3·6H2O were combined in MeCN with H3tea (1.71 g, 11.5 mmol), heated at 80 °C (25 min then 50 min after decantation), filtered, and crystallized from MeCN.
